_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: the unread filter also keeps read chats with foreground, background, or delegated work. The viewport is 1280x900, where the drawer stays open. The test lists only conversation {{ID}}, as read; the live update stream is cut off. What else it lists depends on the activity the test sets with calls: after "activity-foreground" (the setting at first) {{ID}} is working; after "activity-background" it is idle but runs a background job; after "activity-delegated" it is idle but has a working subagent; after "activity-idle" it is idle. The activity applies from the next page load on. Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"). "The toggle" is data-testid "unread-toggle", and its state is its aria-pressed attribute. "The panel" is data-testid "tag-filter-panel". Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. "Filter at A" means: call "activity-A", navigate to /new, click the button "Search conversations...", then click the toggle. 1. Filter at foreground. 2. The row of {{ID}} is visible, and it does not have the class conversation-item-unread. 3. Filter at background. 4. The row of {{ID}} is visible, and it does not have the class conversation-item-unread. 5. Filter at delegated. 6. The row of {{ID}} is visible, and it does not have the class conversation-item-unread. 7. Filter at idle. 8. The row of {{ID}} is not visible (assert_not_visible), and data-testid "unread-filter-empty" is visible.
